name: Encorp | Homework | Week 03 | HW 01 | Customer Feedback Sentiment

parameters.content:
## Customer Feedback Sentiment (Week 03 / HW 01)
Manual Trigger -> sample feedback -> Sentiment Analysis -> enrich -> filter negative -> output + email.

**Coverage**
- R1 Manual Trigger + Customer Feedback Samples
- R2 Sentiment Analysis (+ OpenRouter Chat Model, temperature 0)
- R3 Merge Results + Enrich Feedback (analyzedAt, sentiment, strength, confidence)
- R4 Filter Negative
- R5 Negative Feedback Output
- R6 Build Email + Send Email (bonus)
- R7 Flag Urgent Cases: urgent = strength >= 0.7 AND confidence >= 0.7 (bonus)

Setup: connect OpenRouter + Gmail credentials, set the recipient in Send Email.
